SweetBot · AI says:

Our return & refund policy is designed to be simple and risk‑free:

Mattresses: 100‑night trial from delivery.
Unopened/unused: within 30 days, free prepaid label, 100% refund once in transit.
Opened: after a required 30‑night adjustment and within 100 days, free return/donation if in sanitary, donatable condition.
Toppers: 30‑day trial.
Unopened/unused or restorable to original packaging within 30 days: free label, full refund after tracking shows return in transit.
Opened: within 30 days, free return if sanitary and donatable.
Pillows, bedding, bed frames:
Unopened: 30 days with free label and full refund.
Opened: covered by warranty only (no change‑of‑mind returns).
Refund method: always back to the original payment method (card, bank, or financing account). If your bank/card changed, your bank typically reroutes or issues a check; for financing, refunds go to that account.
Damaged/defective items: handled under our warranty, not standard returns.
Order cancellation:
If not shipped when we process your request, we can cancel and refund.
If already shipped, we may try to intercept, or you can refuse delivery or arrange a return of an unopened package for refund once received intact.
Lost or damaged in transit can also be canceled and refunded if you don’t want a reshipment.

If you believe your situation qualifies for a return, refund, or cancellation, email our Customer Care Team with your Order ID, contact info, photos (if applicable), and a brief issue description so we can review and process your request as quickly as possible.
